Subject: [Action required] Medisync evaluation — MAP & 45-day plan

Hi Priya,

It was great talking earlier — excited to get Medisync into a focused evaluation cadence. Attached is a first-cut Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out proposed milestones, owners, and a 45-day close timeline. High-level goals I heard on the call:

- Validate LLM-driven document classification for claims triage (success: >= 85% accuracy on our test set)
- Integrate Redwood embeddings for fast semantic search across claims metadata
- Prove end-to-end inference latency at target load (p95 <= 250ms for 2k reqs/min)

Proposed kickoff & cadence:
- Quick 30-min kickoff (intro + roles) this week — I can host and walk the MAP
- Weekly 45-min technical syncs led by your engineering team + our solutions engineer
- Decision checkpoint (pilot go/no-go) at day 30; contract/commit discussion by day 45

Concrete asks for today:
1) Confirm the primary champion (I have you listed) and who will own procurement.
2) Share the 2–3 internal stakeholders who should be on the MAP (product, infra, procurement).
3) Pick two 30-min slots for a kickoff (options below).

Scheduling options (PDT):
- Thu Mar 11, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Mar 11, 15:00–15:30
- Fri Mar 12, 09:00–09:30

I attached a draft MAP (spreadsheet) with suggested owners and a short SOW stub. I’ll update the MAP once you confirm stakeholders.

Attachments: MAP-draft-20270310.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB); SOW-template-brief.pdf (pdf, 14KB)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners and timing.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
